work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CII erects a vicariate apostolic for the Paris Foreign Missions on the Coromandel coast; LF19605 de → LF19620 apostolicae across a tiny mark LF19608, the provenance of the preceding brief LF19611, own provenance LF19614 and the page-133 running title LF19617; complete 8 July 1836 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF19577–19577; the source closing at LF19630–19633 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Ma- iorem, sub annulo piscatoris die octava iulii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pon- tificatus nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
